extra.ariaLabel: React's aria-label labels the close button; an aria-label attribute would label the notification.

extra.ariaCurrent: React's aria-current goes to the item's link, which Carbon styles as the current page; an aria-current attribute would go to the <li>.
extra.route: Ember-only, for links within the app: Carbon React takes a router Link component as `as`, which Ember can't hand arbitrary arguments to; this renders Ember's LinkTo (#1040).
extra.models: The models for @route's dynamic segments, as LinkTo's @models (#1040).

missing.target: A plain attribute, through `...attributes`, as on a native `<a>`.

values.direction: Carbon React's OverflowMenu only supports top and bottom: its default menuOffset throws for left and right, which its type allows.

missing.closeMenu: OverflowMenu yields the item bound to it (@menu), which closes the menu; Carbon React clones these props into its children.
missing.handleOverflowMenuItemFocus: OverflowMenu yields the item bound to it (@menu), whose RovingFocus moves between items; Carbon React clones these props into its children.
missing.index: OverflowMenu yields the item bound to it (@menu), whose RovingFocus keeps the items in DOM order; Carbon React clones these props into its children.
